explanation: His publisher, Bennett Cerf, bet him that he could not write a book with only 50 distinct words. Seuss won the bet with the 1960 book.

claims.text: Green Eggs and Ham uses exactly 50 different words.
Bennett Cerf, Dr. Seuss's publisher, bet him that he could not write a book using only 50 different words.
Green Eggs and Ham was published in 1960.
